info.title: API Products
info.description: API for managing tour package products.

get.description: Returns a list of cities which has the highest reviews of their tour packages.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of cities

get.summary: Retrieve a list of all tour packages
get.description: Returns a list of available tour packages.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of products

success.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tour package.

name.description: The name of the tour package.

slug.description: URL-friendly version of the package name.

description.example: Dive into the artistic and cultural history of Paris.

price.description: Price of the tour package in the smallest currency unit.

capacity.description: Maximum number of participants. Can be null if not specified.

date_from.description: Start date of the tour package.

date_until.description: End date of the tour package.

get.summary: Get a single tour package by slug
get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific tour package using the package's slug.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The slug of the tour package

data.description: The detailed information about the tour package.

id.description: The unique identifier of the product.

name.description: The name of the tour package.

description.description: A description of the tour package.
description.example: Experience the top attractions and activities in Tokyo.

image.description: The URL of the tour package's image. Can be null if no image is available.

city.description: City where the tour takes place.

country.description: Country where the tour takes place.

price.description: Price of the tour package in the smallest currency unit.

reviews.description: List of reviews for the tour package.

comment.example: Absolutely loved it! The mix of traditional and modern Tokyo was amazing. Would definitely book again.

review_date.description: Date when the review was posted.

product_details.description: List of product details for each day of the tour.

title.description: Title of the activity on this day.

image.description: Image URL for the activity. Can be null.

description.example: Visit iconic landmarks including the Tokyo Tower.
